manifest.title: 开口练 · 英语口语训练
manifest.releaseNotes: 首批 10 个核心句型，共 100 句。

spanish.name: 西班牙语发音规则（视频搜索）

courses.name: want / need / plan to + 动词
I’m going to / I’m planning to
用过去式说今天做了什么
I don’t + 动词
courses.explanation: 一般现在时的否定：I don’t 后面接动词原形。不要把 be 动词和普通动词混用。

sentences.zh: 我现在不怎么玩英雄联盟了。
sentences.en: I don't play League of Legends much anymore.
sentences.wrong: I'm not play League of Legends.

sentences.en: I don't stay up late very often.
sentences.wrong: I'm not stay up late.

sentences.en: I don't want to go out today.
sentences.wrong: I not want go out today.

sentences.en: I don't know that streamer.
sentences.wrong: I'm not know that streamer.

sentences.en: I don't like waiting in line.
sentences.wrong: I don't like wait in line.

sentences.en: I don't play games during class.
sentences.wrong: I'm not play games in class.

sentences.en: I don't really understand this rule.
sentences.wrong: I'm not understand this rule.

sentences.en: I don't watch streams every day.
sentences.wrong: I doesn't watch streams every day.

sentences.en: I don't mind eating alone.
sentences.wrong: I don't mind eat alone.

sentences.en: I don't remember that word.
sentences.wrong: I'm not remember that word.

courses.name: I’m not + 形容词 / doing
courses.explanation: I’m not 后面可以接形容词，或动词 -ing 表示现在没有正在做。普通动词的习惯性否定用 I don’t。

sentences.en: I'm not tired right now.
sentences.wrong: I don't tired now.

sentences.en: I'm not playing games right now.
sentences.wrong: I don't playing games now.

sentences.en: I'm not sure about this answer.
sentences.wrong: I don't sure about this answer.

sentences.en: I'm not listening to music.
sentences.wrong: I'm not listen to music.

sentences.en: I'm not busy today.
sentences.wrong: I don't busy today.

sentences.zh: 我没在看直播，我在写作业。
sentences.en: I'm not watching a stream. I'm doing homework.
sentences.wrong: I'm not watch a stream.

sentences.zh: 我对这部电影不感兴趣。
sentences.en: I'm not interested in this movie.
sentences.wrong: I don't interested in this movie.

sentences.en: I'm not ready yet.
sentences.wrong: I don't ready yet.

sentences.en: I'm not joking.
sentences.wrong: I don't joking.

sentences.en: I'm not hungry right now.
sentences.wrong: I don't hungry now.

courses.name: I’ve been + -ing
courses.explanation: have been + 动词 -ing 表示一段时间以来持续或反复发生的活动；lately/recently 很常搭配。
courses.commonMistakes: I have been watch ✗；I been watching ✗

sentences.zh: 我最近一直在看云顶之弈直播。
sentences.en: I've been watching TFT streams lately.
sentences.wrong: I have been watch TFT lately.

sentences.zh: 我最近一直在听英语播客。
sentences.en: I've been listening to English podcasts lately.
sentences.wrong: I've been listen to podcasts.

sentences.en: I've been working on assignments all week.
sentences.wrong: I have been work on assignments.

sentences.zh: 我最近一直在练英语口语。
sentences.en: I've been practicing spoken English lately.
sentences.wrong: I have been practice English.

sentences.en: I haven't been sleeping very well lately.
sentences.wrong: I haven't been sleep well.

sentences.zh: 我最近一直在读这本小说。
sentences.en: I've been reading this novel recently.
sentences.wrong: I have been read this novel.

sentences.en: I've been waiting for my friend to reply.
sentences.wrong: I've been wait for my friend.

sentences.zh: 我最近一直在考虑旅行。
sentences.en: I've been thinking about traveling lately.
sentences.wrong: I have been think about traveling.

sentences.zh: 我最近一直在学一点西班牙语。
sentences.en: I've been learning a little Spanish lately.
sentences.wrong: I've been learn Spanish.

sentences.zh: 我今天一直在找我的耳机。
sentences.en: I've been looking for my earbuds all day.
sentences.wrong: I have been look for my earbuds.

courses.name: want / need / plan to + 动词
courses.explanation: want、need、plan 后面通常用 to + 动词原形。plan to 表示计划做。

sentences.en: I want to listen to a podcast for a while.
sentences.wrong: I want listen to a podcast.

sentences.en: I need to review these sentence patterns.
sentences.wrong: I need review these patterns.

sentences.en: I plan to go out this weekend.
sentences.wrong: I plan going out this weekend.

sentences.en: I want to improve my speaking.
sentences.wrong: I want improve my speaking.

sentences.en: I need to go to bed earlier.
sentences.wrong: I need go to bed earlier.

sentences.en: I plan to do my homework tomorrow.
sentences.wrong: I plan do my homework tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 我想学会自然地表达自己。
sentences.en: I want to express myself naturally.
sentences.wrong: I want express myself naturally.

sentences.en: I need to charge my phone.
sentences.wrong: I need charging my phone.

sentences.en: I want to try another game.
sentences.wrong: I want try another game.

sentences.en: I plan to travel during summer break.
sentences.wrong: I plan traveling during summer break.

courses.name: spend time (on) doing
courses.explanation: spend + 时间 + doing；spend + 时间 + on + 名词。不要在 spend time 后面接 to do。

sentences.zh: 我大部分时间都在看小说。
sentences.en: I spend most of my time reading novels.
sentences.wrong: I spend most of my time to read novels.

sentences.zh: 我昨晚花了两个小时看直播。
sentences.en: I spent two hours watching streams last night.
sentences.wrong: I spent two hours to watch streams.

sentences.zh: 我每天花一点时间练口语。
sentences.en: I spend a little time practicing speaking every day.
sentences.wrong: I spend time to practice speaking.

sentences.zh: 我周末经常花时间待在家。
sentences.en: I often spend my weekends relaxing at home.
sentences.wrong: I spend my weekends to relax at home.

sentences.zh: 我在这份作业上花了很长时间。
sentences.en: I spent a lot of time on this assignment.
sentences.wrong: I spent a lot of time in this assignment.

sentences.zh: 我不想花太多时间刷短视频。
sentences.en: I don't want to spend too much time scrolling through short videos.
sentences.wrong: I don't want to spend time to scroll videos.

sentences.zh: 我今天花了半小时听播客。
sentences.en: I spent half an hour listening to a podcast today.
sentences.wrong: I spent half an hour to listen.

sentences.zh: 我花了一个下午整理笔记。
sentences.en: I spent the afternoon organizing my notes.
sentences.wrong: I spent the afternoon to organize notes.

sentences.zh: 我通常花更多时间读书而不是看电影。
sentences.en: I usually spend more time reading than watching movies.
sentences.wrong: I spend more time to read than watch movies.

sentences.zh: 我想少花点时间玩手机。
sentences.en: I want to spend less time on my phone.
sentences.wrong: I want to spend less time in my phone.

courses.name: be good at doing
courses.explanation: be good at + 名词 / 动词 -ing，表示擅长某件事；not very good at 表示不太擅长。
examples: I’m not good at remembering names.

sentences.en: I'm not very good at remembering words.
sentences.wrong: I'm not good at remember words.

sentences.en: I'm pretty good at playing top lane.
sentences.wrong: I'm good to play top lane.

sentences.en: I'm not good at speaking in public.
sentences.wrong: I'm not good at speak in public.

sentences.zh: 我朋友很擅长云顶之弈。
sentences.en: My friend is really good at TFT.
sentences.wrong: My friend is good in TFT.

sentences.zh: 我擅长找到好看的小说。
sentences.en: I'm good at finding interesting novels.
sentences.wrong: I'm good at find novels.

sentences.en: I'm not very good at remembering names.
sentences.wrong: I'm not good at remember names.

sentences.zh: 我正在努力变得更擅长聊天。
sentences.en: I'm trying to get better at having conversations.
sentences.wrong: I'm trying to get better at have conversations.

sentences.zh: 她很擅长解释复杂的东西。
sentences.en: She's good at explaining complicated things.
sentences.wrong: She's good at explain things.

sentences.en: I'm not good at getting up early.
sentences.wrong: I'm not good at get up early.

sentences.zh: 我觉得自己更擅长听而不是说。
sentences.en: I think I'm better at listening than speaking.
sentences.wrong: I'm better at listen than speak.

courses.name: the same as / different from
courses.explanation: the same as = 和……一样；different from = 和……不同。same 前面通常需要 the。

sentences.zh: 云顶之弈和英雄联盟不一样。
sentences.en: TFT is different from League of Legends.
sentences.wrong: TFT is different with League of Legends.

sentences.en: My habits are the same as before.
sentences.wrong: My habits are same to before.

sentences.en: My opinion is the same as yours.
sentences.wrong: My opinion is same to yours.

sentences.zh: 这个版本和旧版不一样。
sentences.en: This version is different from the old one.
sentences.wrong: This version is different with the old one.

sentences.zh: 我们喜欢的小说类型不一样。
sentences.en: We like different kinds of novels.
sentences.wrong: We like difference kinds of novels.

sentences.zh: 这个问题和上一个一样。
sentences.en: This question is the same as the last one.
sentences.wrong: This question is same to last one.

sentences.zh: 我现在的生活和高中时不一样。
sentences.en: My life now is different from high school.
sentences.wrong: My life now is different with high school.

sentences.zh: 我和朋友的看法不一样。
sentences.en: My opinion is different from my friend's.
sentences.wrong: My opinion is different with my friend.

sentences.zh: 这个主播和我以前看的不一样。
sentences.en: This streamer is different from the ones I used to watch.
sentences.wrong: This streamer is different with I watched.

sentences.zh: 对我来说，两个选择差不多。
sentences.en: To me, the two options are pretty much the same.
sentences.wrong: For me, two options is same.

courses.name: I’m going to / I’m planning to
courses.explanation: be going to + 动词表示打算做；be planning to + 动词强调正在计划。不要漏掉 be。

sentences.en: I'm going to bed early tonight.
sentences.wrong: I going to bed early tonight.

sentences.en: I'm going to practice English tomorrow.
sentences.wrong: I'm going practice English tomorrow.

sentences.en: I'm planning to travel next month.
sentences.wrong: I'm planning travel next month.

sentences.zh: 我今晚准备看一会儿直播。
sentences.en: I'm going to watch some streams tonight.
sentences.wrong: I going to watch streams tonight.

sentences.zh: 我打算周末把作业做完。
sentences.en: I'm going to finish my homework this weekend.
sentences.wrong: I'm going finish my homework.

sentences.zh: 我正在计划一次短途旅行。
sentences.en: I'm planning to take a short trip.
sentences.wrong: I'm planning taking a short trip.

sentences.en: I'm going to the library tomorrow.
sentences.wrong: I going to the library tomorrow.

sentences.zh: 我准备换一种学习方法。
sentences.en: I'm going to try a different way of studying.
sentences.wrong: I going try different way.

sentences.zh: 我打算把这句话记在笔记本里。
sentences.en: I'm going to write this sentence in my notebook.
sentences.wrong: I'm going write this sentence.

sentences.zh: 我计划每天听十分钟英语。
sentences.en: I'm planning to listen to English for ten minutes a day.
sentences.wrong: I'm planning listen to English.

courses.name: enjoy / like / love + -ing
courses.explanation: enjoy 后面接名词或动词 -ing；like/love 后面也常接 -ing 来表达兴趣爱好。

sentences.zh: 我喜欢看云顶之弈直播。
sentences.en: I enjoy watching TFT streams.
sentences.wrong: I enjoy to watch TFT streams.

sentences.en: I like reading novels at night.
sentences.wrong: I like read novels at night.

sentences.en: I love listening to people tell stories.
sentences.wrong: I love listen people tell stories.

sentences.en: I don't enjoy waiting for the bus.
sentences.wrong: I don't enjoy to wait for the bus.

sentences.en: I enjoy spending time alone.
sentences.wrong: I enjoy to spend time alone.

sentences.zh: 我喜欢边走路边听播客。
sentences.en: I like listening to podcasts while walking.
sentences.wrong: I like listen to podcasts while walking.

sentences.en: I enjoy discovering new novels.
sentences.wrong: I enjoy to discover new novels.

sentences.en: I love chatting with my friends.
sentences.wrong: I love chat with friends.

sentences.en: I don't like being interrupted.
sentences.wrong: I don't like be interrupted.

sentences.zh: 我喜欢用英语表达自己的想法。
sentences.en: I enjoy expressing my thoughts in English.
sentences.wrong: I enjoy to express my thoughts.

courses.name: 用过去式说今天做了什么
courses.explanation: 说今天已经做过的事，用一般过去时：went、ate、watched、spent、stayed、read（过去式拼写相同）。
examples: I spent the day at home.

sentences.zh: 我今天只出去吃了一次饭。
sentences.en: I only went out once to get something to eat today.
sentences.wrong: I only go out once today.

sentences.zh: 我今天大部分时间都在房间里。
sentences.en: I spent most of today in my room.
sentences.wrong: I spend most of today in my room.

sentences.en: I watched streams for a long time last night.
sentences.wrong: I was watch streams last night.

sentences.en: I listened to a podcast episode today.
sentences.wrong: I listen a podcast today.

sentences.en: I finished my homework this afternoon.
sentences.wrong: I finish my homework this afternoon.

sentences.en: I woke up late this morning.
sentences.wrong: I wake up late this morning.

sentences.en: I read a few chapters of a novel today.
sentences.wrong: I was read some chapters today.

sentences.en: I forgot that word just now.
sentences.wrong: I forget that word just now.

sentences.zh: 我昨天和朋友聊了很久。
sentences.en: I talked with my friend for a long time yesterday.
sentences.wrong: I talk with my friend yesterday.

sentences.zh: 我今天学到了一个新表达。
sentences.en: I learned a new expression today.
sentences.wrong: I learn a new expression today.
